c74object.name: fidddle~
c74object.digest: Polyphonic pitch detector for string instruments
c74object.description: Detects up to four simultaneous pitches in a mono audio signal from a bowed or plucked string instrument (cello profile), tracks them over time, and outputs note events as a MIDI-style list plus continuous per-voice frequency and level signals. Each sounding note holds a persistent voice slot (0 to 3) until its note-off, so the signal outlets follow a note through vibrato and glissando. Note-ons are delivered roughly 70 to 90 ms after the physical onset (the analysis window length).

entry.name: signal
entry.description: Outlets 0-3: frequency in Hz of voice slots 0-3 (0 when the slot is silent). Outlets 4-7: linear level of voice slots 0-3.

entry.name: list
entry.description: Outlet 8: midinote velocity slot. A velocity of 0 is a note-off. A re-attack of a ringing note sends the note-off and then the note-on.

inlet.description: Mono audio signal, ideally a close-miked or pickup signal. Also accepts the messages reset and info.

outlet.description: Frequency of voice slot 0 in Hz, 0 when silent.
Frequency of voice slot 1 in Hz, 0 when silent.
Frequency of voice slot 2 in Hz, 0 when silent.
Frequency of voice slot 3 in Hz, 0 when silent.
Linear level of voice slot 0, 0 when silent.
Linear level of voice slot 1, 0 when silent.
Linear level of voice slot 2, 0 when silent.
Linear level of voice slot 3, 0 when silent.
A list of three integers. Velocity 0 means note-off.
Messages analysis, timing_us and latency_ms in response to the info message.

method.name: reset
method.description: Discards all tracking state and rebuilds the detector with the current attribute values.

method.name: info
method.digest: Report analysis settings, timing and latency
method.description: Sends from the right outlet: analysis (sample rate and window size), timing_us (mean and maximum analysis time per hop in microseconds, the hop budget, and the number of dropped events), and latency_ms (mean and maximum delay between the estimated physical onset and the note-on, and the number of notes measured).

attribute.name: voices
attribute.description: The most notes tracked at once, 1 to 4. A lower value uses less CPU and gives fewer false extra notes. Default 4.

attribute.name: minlevel
attribute.description: Notes quieter than this level are ignored, -90 to -20 dBFS. Raise it to reject room noise and ringing. Default -58.

attribute.name: confirm
attribute.description: How many analysis frames (about 5.8 ms each at 44.1 kHz) a new pitch must persist before a note-on is sent, 2 to 24. Higher values reject short false notes but add latency. Default 6.

attribute.name: release
attribute.description: How long a note may go unsupported by the analysis before its note-off is sent, 50 to 1000 ms. Higher values bridge dropouts but delay note-offs. Default 100.

attribute.name: retrigger
attribute.description: How much louder (in dB) the partials of a ringing note must become for a repeated pluck to retrigger it, 3 to 30. Lower values retrigger more easily but may split sustained notes. Default 10.
